question: Where can I get a list of hydropower plants and dams in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), reservoir volume, operator and annual generation?

answer.summary: No single un-gated official dataset covers all Spanish hydropower plants with MW, operator, reservoir volume, and annual generation. For dams, MITECO's UP_Presas_y_embalses ArcGIS REST service covers 3,208 dams and 3,170 reservoirs with coordinates, volume (hm3), and operator. For hydro plants, MITECO's WFS (876 plants) lacks MW in 88% of rows and omits operators; PRETOR/REPROv2 use CAPTCHAs; Electra's bulk dump omits technology. Non-official datasets are also partial (JRC 342 plants and WRI 124 plants lack small-hydro operators and current annual MWh); pair them with basin/regional sources (CH Duero, CH Jucar, CH Cantabrico, INEGA, DERA).
main_caveats: MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses USO mislabels major hydro dams (ALDEADAVILA, ALCANTARA, ALMENDRA, CORTES II) as Abastecimiento; never filter USO to find hydro dams.
In UP_Presas_y_embalses Layer 0, multi-dike dams repeat rows (ALMENDRA x4) each repeating full NMN_CAPAC; sum volume from Layer 1 (Embalses) and filter FASE='Explotación'.
MITECO WFS agua:aprov_hidro_central (876 plants) has potencia_t=0 in 770/876 rows, lat=0 in 34/876, and no operator; Electra dump lacks tech, >50 MW phases, and froze 2026-01-27.
Observed annual generation per plant is not published nationwide; MITECO, REE REData, and CNMC publish only aggregates, leaving CH Duero, CH Jucar, and ENTSO-E (>=100 MW).
MITECO static dam Shapefiles use an Altcha anti-bot gate and RAIPRE queries (PRETOR/REPROv2) use image CAPTCHAs; use MITECO ArcGIS REST UP_Presas_y_embalses instead.
answer.confidence_reason: Directly queried MITECO ArcGIS REST, GeoServer WFS, Electra, REData, CNMC, 9 basins, 5 regional portals, JRC, WRI, ENTSO-E, GeoDAR, GEM, SEPREM, ohsome, and BOE.

attributes.note: All 3,208 MITECO ArcGIS dams and 342/342 JRC plants have coords; 34/876 MITECO WFS plants have lat=0; Electra, CH Duero, and INEGA lack coords.
attributes.gap_note: Electra, CH Duero, and INEGA Galicia plant registries omit coordinates, and 34/876 MITECO WFS plant points have corrupted latitude=0 coordinates.

attributes.note: MITECO WFS gives kW in only 106/876 rows; Electra omits >50 MW Fases; JRC gives 342/342 plants (16,084.5 MW); basins/regions cover local plants.
attributes.gap_note: No single un-gated official open dataset provides MW capacity for both >50 MW (REPROv2 CAPTCHA) and <=50 MW (PRETOR CAPTCHA) hydro plants nationwide.

attributes.note: MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses gives NMN_CAPAC (hm3) for 2,672/3,170 reservoirs and Embalses_Mapa covers 375 >5 hm3 weekly; JRC links volume to 62/342 plants.
attributes.gap_note: 498/3,170 minor reservoirs in MITECO Layer 1 lack NMN_CAPAC, and no official national dataset provides a join key linking reservoir volume to hydro plants.

attributes.note: MITECO ArcGIS gives TITULAR for 3,185/3,208 dams; MITECO WFS/Electra omit plant operator (PRETOR/REPROv2 CAPTCHA); WRI covers 124 plants; INEGA covers Galicia.
attributes.gap_note: MITECO omits Titular from Electra bulk dumps and WFS; CH Cantabrico redacts natural-person owners under LO 3/2018; PRETOR/REPROv2 public queries use CAPTCHA.

attributes.note: Not published per plant nationwide (REE/MITECO/CNMC give totals); CH Duero (169/435) and CH Jucar (33/60) publish basin MWh; ENTSO-E covers >=100 MW units.
attributes.gap_note: MITECO, REE (REData), and CNMC publish generation only aggregated nationally, regionally, or by technology; only CH Duero, CH Jucar, and ENTSO-E (>=100 MW) publish unit/plant MWh.
